Kill [[Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna in the [[Archipelagos]].
* *BONUS* Kill Ssuns in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 500 [[Allegiance rank|Luxon Faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
The route from [[Cavalon]] doesn't require you to fight [[Ssyn Coiled Grasp]]. Exit into the Archipelagos and head east, dispatching the first mob of fish that you encounter, then continue until you reach the edge of the map and head south.  Now head for the boss, killing the patroling Naga and the two stationary Naga mobs in front of the boss.  Engage and kill Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna to complete the bounty. 

If taking the route from [[Jade Flats (Luxon)]], your [[party]] will only encounter [[Naga Warrior]]s, [[Naga Archer]]s, [[Naga Ritualist]]s, Ssyn Coiled Grasp, and a few [[Kappa (level 23)|Kappa]]. [[List of hex removal skills|Hex removal skills]] are unnecessary if your party does not contain any allies that require [[attack]]s and [[attack skill]]s to deal damage, since your party will only encounter a total of two Kappas who use [[Blurred Vision]] and [[Shatterstone]] (whose end effect triggers even if the hex is removed). Consider not bringing [[block]]ing skills, since they can be bypassed by Naga Warriors and Archers. Naga Warriors and Archers can also [[interrupt]] with [[Distracting Blow]] and [[Concussion Shot]], so consider skills that can prevent interrupts, inflict [[blind]] or cause [[miss]]es. Consider [[Signet of Binding]] for [[Destruction]] spirits created by  Naga Ritualists and Ssyn Coiled Grasp.
